editions.title: Zelda Sells Five Million; Cats Get A Simulator
editions.standfirst: Terry and Reggie go through the last few days in gaming and argue about all of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.
editions.terry: That's the gaming news, ladies and gentlemen! Every word made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and slightly less shouty. Press start tomorrow morning, seven ish!
editions.reggie: Check the box underneath, my old son, that's where the truth lives. And if the arguing gets you down, my fee for refereeing is a tenner, payable in cash, no console required.

stories.headline: Hero Sells 5.2 Million Copies Before Anyone Has Found The Last Heart Piece
stories.satire: Terry calls it the greatest comeback in history and wants a parade for a man whose main skill is a small flute. Reggie points out the hero never says a word and still out-earns the pair of them, which he calls the perfect business model. They argued about it until teatime, then Reggie raised an invoice for services as a silent protagonist. It is for a tenner, and it is silent too.
stories.real: Nintendo said the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake sold more than 5.2 million copies worldwide in its first four days on Switch 2 after its 5 November launch, which it says is the fastest start for any game it has published on the console.

stories.headline: Fourteen Games Launch In One Day; Nation Can Now Be A Cat, A Banker Or A Cleaner
stories.satire: Terry has chosen the cat, on the grounds that nobody expects a cat to file a tax return. Reggie has gone for the banker and has already approved himself for a very friendly loan. They argued for an hour over who gets the house cleaner, then agreed that whoever loses has to do the real washing up. Terry is still looking for the kitten's off switch.
stories.real: PureXbox counted 14 games launching on Xbox on 13 November, including Cat Simulator, Banker Simulator and House Cleaner Simulator.

link.text: Want a cat game with tricycles and a promenade full of Dreamies? Play Grand Theft Kitty.

stories.headline: Third Instalment Confirmed 'In Production'; Production Confirmed To Be Where Games Come From
stories.satire: Terry announced it to the studio at full volume and is now doing a lap of honour round the sofa. Reggie wants it in writing, in triplicate, with a delivery date and a small deposit, my old son. They disagreed on whether three is a number to get excited about, and settled it by counting on their fingers. There was a recount. Reggie won on a technicality.
stories.real: Game Informer reported on 13 November that Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production.

stories.headline: God Of War Spin-Off Heads For The PS4; The Console Is Thrilled To Be Asked
stories.satire: Terry wept at the news and then asked what a PS4 was. Reggie has one in the loft, under a tea chest, and describes it as vintage and therefore appreciating. They argued over whether a console that has been up in the loft for years counts as retired or just resting. Reggie says it is resting and wants to charge it a storage fee.
stories.real: Instant Gaming reported on 13 November that the Metroidvania spin-off God of War: Sons of Sparta will get a free content update and launch on PS4 on 16 November.

stories.headline: Halo Remake Gets Firefight Mode; Terry Insists On Being The Fire
stories.satire: Terry says he will be the Fire. Reggie says that makes him the Fight, and also the one who does the paperwork afterwards. They have not fought, which is rather the opposite of the brief. The argument went on for forty minutes before somebody pointed out that the mode is for several players at once, and the two of them had been sitting on the same sofa.
stories.real: Instant Gaming reported on 13 November that Halo: Campaign Evolved, the remake of the first Halo's story, is getting a new mode called Firefight.

stories.headline: Golden Trophies Await; Nominees Told To Look Casual Until Tuesday
stories.satire: Terry has written four acceptance speeches in the shower, all of them better than any shortlist could deserve. Reggie has put himself forward for Best Supporting Invoice and expects to be unopposed. They argued about who gets to thank whom first, and agreed to thank the cats, who were not consulted. Nominees have until Tuesday to practise a face for losing graciously.
stories.real: Final Weapon reported on 14 November that the Game Awards 2026 nominees will be announced in a live stream on 17 November, with the ceremony itself on 10 December.

stories.headline: Boxed Edition Contains A Code, Not A Disc; Nation Opens Box, Finds Slightly Fancier Receipt
stories.satire: Terry opened the box expecting a disc and found a card with a code on it. He is calling it a very elaborate envelope. Reggie is delighted: a smart box with nothing in it is the oldest trick in the book, he says, and he has sold a fair few in his time. They argued over whether the box counts as part of the game, and Reggie has put in a bid for all the empty ones.
stories.real: A roundup of Rockstar's Newswire post of 10 November says boxed copies of GTA VI, due in shops from 12 November, contain a download code rather than a disc, and that the pre-load needs up to 212 GB of space.

link.text: Our games need no box, no code and no 212GB. Visit the arcade.

stories.headline: Ten Games In Twelve Years, Then Thirteen Years For The Next; Maths Teacher Applauds
stories.satire: Terry did the sums on his fingers and ran out of fingers somewhere around Vice City. Reggie thinks it is the only business where the longer you keep the customer waiting, the more they thank you, and he intends to try it with his invoices. They argued over whether this counts as a clever idea or just a very long lunch. The calendar has not commented.
stories.real: GamesRadar noted on 14 November that Rockstar released the first ten Grand Theft Auto games in just twelve years, as the 13-year wait for GTA 6 comes to an end.

stories.headline: Parcel-Delivery Game Joins Subscription Library; Nation Told To Take Its Time
stories.satire: Terry has promised to carry every parcel across the whole country by hand and is already out of breath on the landing. Reggie says the real money is in the boxes, not the walking, and has offered to supply the boxes at a very fair price. They argued about who has to carry the heavy one. The cat, who weighs less than both, has gone on ahead.
stories.real: Fandomwire reported on 14 November that PlayStation's November Game Catalog additions include the PS5 game Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, arriving on 17 November.

stories.headline: Minigame Loses Certain Words; Minigame Asks Which Ones
stories.satire: Terry typed a word to see if it had gone. Reggie typed his invoice number. Both were refused, and the keyboard now appears to be on a go-slow. They argued about which of them had written the worst word and agreed it was the one Terry will not repeat. Reggie wants it noted that his invoice number is a very clean number and he was the injured party.
stories.real: GamesRadar reported on 14 November that Final Fantasy 14 patched certain words out of Keyboard Brawler, a limited-time minigame in the game.
